svg.text: How many eggs does a month of a graduate's pay buy?
Average monthly earnings of employees with tertiary education ÷ farm-gate price of one hen egg (60 g) · shared log scale
Data: ILOSTAT EAR_EMTA_SEX_EDU_CUR_NB (advanced education, both sexes, USD × World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF); FAOSTAT Producer Prices; World Bank NY.GNP.PCAP.CN
Graduates nationwide: no source splits earnings by education AND urban/rural. Farm-gate prices (retail ≈ 1.5–3× higher).
